reviews.author: Jewel E…
reviews.body: Absolutely the BEST pedicure experience! From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed & pampered. This private salon is beautifully decorated, luxurious, and incredibly relaxing. She takes so much pride in her work and her attention to detail is second to none. Her warm personality, outstanding customer service, and genuine hospitality makes every visit special. The complimentary coffee is amazing, and the entire experience feels like a day at a five-star resort. Free parking & convenient hours is the icing on the cake. If you're looking for quality, luxury, and exceptional service, this is the place to go. I can't recommend her enough!
